Return a lambda from a function (closure) to make a doubler and a tripler.

Supplied answer
def multiplier(n):
    return lambda a: a * n # remembers n
doubler = multiplier(2)
tripler = multiplier(3)
print(doubler(5)) # 10
print(tripler(5)) # 15
Note: A function that remembers a value from the outer function is called a closure.
